title: SCIM staged deprovisioning with orphan-detection, rollback and rate-aware retry strategy
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Our current SCIM deprovisioning flow retries aggressively on failures and can orphan accounts when downstream identity changes (group removals, external account reassignments) happen during rollouts. We also lack an operator-facing way to safely halt/rollback a mass deprovision and poor audit signals for partial failures.

Goal: Implement a staged deprovisioning flow for SCIM users and groups that: 1) detects potential orphaned accounts before hard deletion, 2) records granular audit events for each stage, 3) exposes operator controls to pause/resume/rollback large operations, and 4) uses a rate-aware, backoff-friendly retry system that respects SCIM provider quotas and our Dedicated capacity SLOs.

This ticket covers backend runtime changes, SCIM job orchestration, audit event schema additions, and a minimal Console control surface for operators to inspect and control running deprovision jobs.
acceptance_criteria: Staged deprovisioning implemented: soft-deactivate -> grace period -> final delete with configurable TTL
Orphan detection runs during soft-deactivate and marks accounts needing manual review instead of immediate delete
Retry system respects per-tenant SCIM rate limits and exposes per-job retry metrics in console
Audit log entries emitted for every stage change (soft-deactivate, grace-expire, final-delete, rollback) with request/response metadata
Operator controls added to Console: pause, resume, rollback, and force-delete for a deprovision job
Integration tests simulate SCIM provider 429/5xx patterns and verify exponential backoff + jitter and circuit-breaker behavior
Migration: existing pending deprovision jobs adopt staged model without data loss or duplicate deletes
implementation_notes: Introduce DeprovisionJob entity: id, tenant, targetUsers/groups, stage, created_at, next_retry_at, retry_count, operator_state
Add pre-delete orphan check: verify external identity mapping and cross-tenant group membership; if ambiguous, move to 'needs_manual_review'

Retry semantics: per-tenant token bucket for rate limiting; use exponential backoff with full-jitter and cap at 1 hour; implement circuit-breaker that trips after configurable consecutive 5xx/429 failures
Audit events: extend audit log schema with scim.job_id, stage, actor, reason, scim_response_code, scim_response_body_preview
Operator API: POST /admin/scim/jobs/{id}/pause, /resume, /rollback, /force_delete. These endpoints are admin-only and require RBAC v2 'scim:manage_jobs' permission
Console: job list + job detail page showing per-target status, last response, retry_count, and links to identity provider logs
Fail-safe: final-delete must double-check tombstone marker and join with tenant retention policy; soft-deactivate exposes 'reversible' flag for 72h by default
rollout_plan: Phase 0: library + tests — implement core job orchestration and retry primitives behind feature flag 'scim_staged_deprovision'
Phase 1: backend rollout — enable flag for internal tenants and run canaries on non-production orgs
Phase 2: audit + console — add operator UI and audit streams; pilot with two enterprise customers
Phase 3: default on — enable for all tenants and run database backfill to convert pending jobs
Rollback plan: feature flag off returns system to previous immediate-delete behavior; record any partial operations and surface manual recovery tasks
